Subject: Quick follow-up + POC success criteria draft

Hi Liam - great to meet earlier today. Thanks for walking us through the evaluation goals. I wanted to capture next steps and a proposed set of success criteria so we're aligned before the trial starts.

High-level POC scope (2 weeks):
- Integration: API connectivity to ingest 3 canonical datasets (patient-summaries, lab-notes, research-annotations).
- Latency/Throughput: p95 inference latency < 250ms at 4 concurrent users; sustain 200 QPS for burst tests.
- Quality: end-to-end accuracy on mapping task >= 88% on your evaluation set; no critical hallucination issues in 95% of sampled prompts.
- Security: SOC2 attestation (see attachment), data retention controls implemented to your retention policy.

Requested ownership:
- Veridian: provide evaluation datasets + final scoring rubric (Priya).
- Redwood: provide sandbox endpoint, sample clients, and weekly readout.

I've attached a short PDF with the above and an MAP (mutual-action-plan) spreadsheet. Can you confirm the criteria and whether a 2-week timeline works? If yes, we'll schedule the kickoff for next Tues and block a final readout week-of May 24.

Thanks - Marissa

--
